card.name: Units right after a dose number
card.fires_on: The unit word (mg, hours, hour, mcg) directly after a number in dosing instructions. Seen in recommended-dosage lines and in timing like "not resolved by 2 hours".

modes.label: Dose amount unit
modes.description: mg or mcg right after a number in a recommended dosage statement.
modes.example: The initial recommended dosage for the management of gout is 100<< mg>> orally daily

modes.label: Time unit after number
modes.description: hour or hours after a number in a wait-and-repeat or follow-up timing instruction.
modes.example: If the migraine has not resolved by 2<< hours>> after taking zolmitriptan

card.plain: It fires on the unit (mg or hours) that comes straight after a number in dosing directions.
